aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: An Egyptologist carrying a haunted ancient artifact must protect it from a power-hungry tech billionaire bent on unlocking eternal life through a deadly mummy's curse.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: When an Egyptologist comes into possession of the haunted Bride of the Dead amulet, she becomes the primary target of an obsessed tech billionaire. Believing the relic holds forbidden magic capable of granting immortality, the magnate will stop at nothing to claim it for himself. However, meddling with the ancient artifact threatens to unleash a devastating mummy curse upon the modern world. Caught in a dangerous game of ambition and supernatural dread, the Egyptologist must safeguard the artifact before ancient forces consume them all.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: An unwitting Egyptologist stumbles upon the rare and haunting Bride of the Dead amulet, an ancient Egyptian artifact shrouded in dark legend. Word of the discovery quickly reaches a ruthlessly ambitious tech billionaire who has long been obsessed with conquering human mortality. Driven by hubris, the billionaire becomes convinced that the amulet acts as a key to forbidden magic capable of granting eternal life. He deploys immense resources and mercenaries to track down the scientist and seize the relic at any cost. As the Egyptologist attempts to evade her pursuers, she begins to experience terrifying supernatural phenomena linked directly to the amulet. She soon realizes that the artifact is not merely a key to immortality, but a dormant prison holding back an ancient, vengeful mummy curse. Ignoring her dire warnings, the billionaire forces an activation of the artifact, inadvertently triggering the sinister magic dormant within. As the ancient force awakens to wreak havoc, the Egyptologist is forced into a desperate race against time to reverse the ritual. Ultimately, she must find a way to contain the curse and seal the dark magic away before it destroys both her captor and the rest of humanity.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Blending elements of atmospheric horror and dark drama, this film follows a dedicated Egyptologist who unexpectedly acquires the Bride of the Dead amulet, a mysterious relic deeply tied to ancient Egyptian folklore. Her life is upended when a wealthy technology tycoon targets her, convinced that the artifact holds the secret to defeating death and attaining eternal life. As tension mounts and supernatural occurrences begin to manifest around the amulet, a high-stakes conflict unfolds between modern corporate greed and powerful ancient magic, setting off a chilling tale of ambition, obsession, and deadly dark forces.

story_structure.climax: A high-stakes confrontation unfolds where the true power of the curse threatens to unleash ancient destruction, forcing a final desperate effort to stop the ritual before eternal evil takes over.
story_structure.conflict: The billionaire seeks to acquire the artifact at all costs, believing its forbidden magic holds the secret to eternal life, while risking the release of a deadly mummy curse.
story_structure.resolution: The immediate supernatural threat is thwarted, leaving the survivors to deal with the aftermath of the ancient magic while securing the cursed relic away from corrupt hands.
story_structure.introduction: An Egyptologist comes into possession of a ancient Bride of the Dead amulet, drawing the attention of a power-hungry tech billionaire obsessed with ancient Egyptian relics.
story_structure.risingAction: As the billionaire's mercenaries pursue the Egyptologist, dangerous supernatural anomalies begin to manifest, escalating the stakes as both sides race to control the power of the amulet.
